TextView.android:text: Stage 1: Timed reading measures pure reading rate (WPM and WPS) with no question distractions.
Stage 2: Phil-IRI comprehension questions (Literal, Inferential, Critical) with optional passage review.
Read silently at your natural pace. When finished, tap 'Done Reading' to record your reading rate and proceed to the questions.
Learner can read and comprehend the text completely without teacher assistance. Ready for advanced enrichment texts.
Comprehension depth across DepEd cognitive levels
This reading passage was challenging. Learners in the Frustration Level benefit greatly from guided reading drills and vocabulary reinforcement to build reading fluency.
